summary: Halliburton filed a routine 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that its independent directors elected Maurice S. Smith as Lead Independent Director effective September 15, 2026, succeeding Robert A. Malone, who remains a director. Smith receives an additional $40,000 annual retainer under the existing non-management director compensation program described in the March 31, 2026 proxy. No stake, price, premium, advisor, or regulatory clock is involved; this is a routine board-governance appointment, not a forced or abrupt CEO/CFO departure. No deal terms, no structural overhang, and no risk-arb angle; watch only routine governance disclosures.
